text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened during a break while wearing her racing silks to shoot promotional material for upcoming races...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...
This place is really well taken care of, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: She pulls out the wilting flowers properly before they completely wither away.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: If you leave things like that, it just ends up wearing down the stocks all around it too.
choice_data_list: You sure know a lot about gardening.
You sure know a lot about gardening.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. My mom used to grow all sorts of flowers
on the balcony, see.
I've been watching her do it since I was little.
choice_data_list: Do you have any favorite flowers in particular?
Do you have any favorite flowers in particular?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... There are plenty of things,
but the one that truly captured my heart and never let go is...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Lilacs, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That was... right, I believe
it was the winter before I enrolled in Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My mother also volunteers for greening initiatives.
I used to help out alongside her, too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "Mom, I already hauled the fertilizer over!"

text_block_list.name: Lara's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, thank you.
That really helps me out."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"What yer plantin' there is lilacs, ain't it?
When do they bloom?"

text_block_list.name: Lara's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"It'll be quite a while before they settle in and bloom.
Even so, look at this seedling—
it's already got flower buds, see?"

text_block_list.name: Lara's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"If she takes root well after the repottin'...
she might just bloom by spring, y'know."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "So... that means these flowers might bloom before I leave for the academy, huh."

text_block_list.name: Lara's Mother
text_block_list.text: "That's right. Flowers that endure the harsh winter... always bloom the most beautifully."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "Is that so? Hehe... I'll be sure to remember that."

text_block_list.name: News
text_block_list.text:
"—Experts warn that severe cold will persist this winter,
raising concerns over potential damage
to crops and greenery."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Mom.
Sounds like this winter's gonna be pretty darn cold."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if the lilacs in the park are doing alright...
Even if they say they're tough against the winter, I can't help but worry a bit."

text_block_list.name: Lara's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Ain't that the truth...
I can totally get why you'd be worried."

text_block_list.name: Lara's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Still, at the end of the day, there's only so much a person can do. Once you've done what you can—
all that's left is to wait."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aye, that year was a brutally cold winter.
I heard on the news all the time about crops getting ruined by the frost.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "I've been going to check on the park from time to time too, but—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Due to the danger of frozen roads and fallen trees,
they've closed it off to everyone
until safety checks are completed.

text_block_list.name: Lara's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"The Tracen Academy uniform really suits you.
To think that next week you'll be moving to Tokyo and entering the academy..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"What's with the sudden formality?
Aw, jeez... you're making me blush."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I'm gonna go for a quick walk.
Wanna get used to moving around in my uniform."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
""Ah. They lifted the entry ban
on this park...""

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "—Ah. Come to think of it, those lilacs...! What's become of 'em now...?!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (No way... After making it through that winter... through such bitter cold...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"'..."Flowers that endure the winter cold to bloom
are more beautiful than any other"... you did it.'"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, but... she didn't just endure it."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"'I'll burn your radiant, dressed-up figure into my memory'—
that's just how they're blooming."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "Truly... well done. In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "I oughta take a leaf out of your book too."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's why, look... this racing attire
has lilacs decorated on it, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No matter how harsh the situation, endure, persevere,
and stand triumphant in the end. That is my way.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Just as flowers survive the winter to bloom in spring—
I will keep standing until my time comes."
choice_data_list: I really mean it. You're the one who deserves to be the star.
I really mean it. You are the one who deserves to be the star.
You've really spent a long time cultivating that way of being, haven't you?
You've built up that way of living over a long time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Just as flowers survive the winter to bloom in spring—
I will keep standing until my time comes."
choice_data_list: I really mean it. You're the one who deserves to be the star.
I really mean it. You are the one who deserves to be the star.
You've really spent a long time cultivating that way of being, haven't you?
You've built up that way of living over a long time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Hearin' you say that...
is real reassurin', honest.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer.
Watch me closely, okay?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: From here on out, a large, light-purple blossom blooming proudly on the racetrack—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah, that's right. Thanks to that flower,
I've got a strong image in mind of me enduring through anything.
So――

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, hello, Mom? Are you free right now? Yeah. It's nothing urgent, though."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Today, I found myself thinking back...
You know, about the lilacs in that park.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for teaching me
that those flowers will bloom so beautifully."
